name: Particle Traces on 2D Surfaces
definition: A technique representing vector field magnitude and direction on arbitrary 2D surfaces by drawing long, evenly spaced particle trace lines composed of contrasting color segments. The segment length represents magnitude (constant time interval), and direction is the vector projected onto the surface.
summary: Particle Traces on 2D Surfaces visualizes 3D vector fields on arbitrary surfaces using evenly spaced, segmented lines with contrasting colors to resolve directional ambiguity.
